Hattori ek hi hai... par kabhi Kenichi ke papa, kabhi mummy, aur kabhi khud Kenichi! Ek insaan, kai roop... isi ko kehte hain Polymorphism!
Poly matlab many, aur morph matlab forms. Yaani ek naam, alag-alag kaam!
Code mein dekho: ek parent class Roop, jismein method hai bolo. Papa, Mummy aur Kenichi, teeno ne bolo ko apne tarike se likha.
Ab ek hi variable r. r mein Papa daalo, toh bolega: padhai karo! Mummy daalo: khana kha lo! Aur Kenichi daalo: mujhe nahi padhna!
Same call, r dot bolo... par result har baar alag! Ise kehte hain runtime polymorphism, yaani method overriding.
